narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Shubman did better, because one hundred and ten is more than ninety six.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Shubman had one extra match in which to score runs.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Comparing totals is not fair when the number of matches is different.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>When the counts differ, compare the means, not the totals.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>The mean is the total shared equally over the values.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Your turn. One friend scores four, six and eight in three games, and another scores nine and three in two. Compare the means.
